method.idleCpu: 100 * delta process user+system CPU seconds / elapsed wall seconds; wait five seconds after capture, sample two seconds; one core = 100%
method.capture: viewport frameSequence before/after idle sample and six status requests
method.status: six synchronous MCP status request round trips; these include UI request handling, not direct pointer latency
method.motion: 30 xdotool right-drag move events; elapsed time is event dispatch time, not frame rate
limitations: Local Linux/X11 software-GPU checks; not a cross-platform or 60 FPS benchmark.
MCP round-trip latency still includes rebuilding surrounding command/property UI.
The fixture matches reported entity counts but is not the original user drawing.
